profile.headline: AWS Alumni - Engineering in Space

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading development of Sophia's software platform for distributed orbital computing systems.

- Defining architecture for the Sophia Operating System (SOOS)
- Embedded firmware and operating system integration across flight compute platforms
- Secure software deployment, update, rollback, and recovery systems
- Spacecraft networking, control planes, and distributed workload management
- Linux platform engineering, CI/CD, and software lifecycle management
- Ground infrastructure, cloud services, security, identity, and developer tooling
- Technical planning, architecture reviews, hiring, vendor evaluation, and engineering enablement
- Collaboration across software, firmware, avionics, payload, and mission operations teams

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Display Protocols (AWS), Amazon Nimble Studio (AWS)

•	Built a virtual smartcard library for Workspaces/AppStream to enable certificate-based authentication
•	Supported dozens of customers in setting up their AD + AWS infrastructure to support certificate-based authentication to reduce their IT management costs
•	Developed Windows drivers to support authentication or device control use cases
•	Designed and debugged systems across the user/kernel boundary, including syscall-level tracing and driver architecture
•	Designed and implemented Identity Center (IdC) streaming integration for Workspaces to support cloud Entra ID environments
•	Developed cloud-native and low-level systems in Rust, C/C++, Python, and PowerShell
•	Optimized JPEG-based video codec using SIMD intrinsics (SSE4, AVX2, AVX512) for simultaneous predictor calculations and colorspace + resolution conversions, leading to 32–45% latency reduction in decoding/encoding in WSPv1
•	Delivered internal presentations on video codec fundamentals to cross-functional teams
•	Mentored junior engineers, conducted 50+ interviews, participated in promotion panels
•	Participated in regular on-call rotations, resolving and mitigating customer-impacting incidents
•	Worked directly with enterprise customers to onboard and troubleshoot AD and IdP configurations
•	Engineered EC2 host and VPC management, AMI lifecycle tooling, and streaming flow components for Amazon Nimble Studio

positions.title: Application Streaming Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Amazon

•	Lead developer for a low-latency, interactive streaming system (e2e) in C++14/17
•	Implemented pen/tablet input support for remote streaming, later folded into Amazon DCV
•	Co-authored a forward error correction (FEC) mechanism enabling 0-RTT communication over UDP
•	Created modular, plugin-based architecture for streaming components validated across AWS and Azure
•	Maintained CI systems and build tooling using CMake, MSBuild, and gcc
•	Company acquired by AWS; work integrated into Amazon DCV stack

positions.title: Software Engineer (MTS)
positions.locationName: 185 Berry St. Ste# 4807, San Francisco, California
positions.description:
- Full-stack, cofounding engineer
- Sole internal IT for SF Office of size ~20
- Worked with a variety of technologies, including but not limited to 
    - iOS Swift (1.1-4.0), Kotlin, Python, C#, Python-Flask, AWS (EC2, S3, Elasticsearch, RDS, DynamoDB, Elasticache), Vagrant, TravisCI/CircleCI/Jenkins, Redis, MongoDB, MySQL, Nagios, FFMPEG, Git
    - Data Security, User Authentication (OTP, 2FA), Data-Sync mechanisms

positions.title: Member of the Board of Directors
positions.description: Served as Treasurer. Left due to a property sale.

positions.title: Software Engineer (MTS)
positions.description:
Worked on a development project that would enable cheaper per-stream costs by changing the infrastructure of the pipeline. Initially brought on to accelerate the v1.0 of the project, later to create ease-of-use tools for deployment and development up to v1.1 whilst addressing bugs and issues. Investigated and tested different framebuffer capture technologies, and assisted in analyzing competitors' latency/bandwidth/quality stream statistics.

Worked on a virtualization project, in which (theoretically) multiple instances could be launched from a single physical unit, further reducing the cost-per stream from a hardware perspective.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Investigated and worked on several technologies, such as hardware H.264 decoding controls under Android devices, as well as transcoding proprietary video streams to natively playable web formats under HTML5 via web interface, streaming via HLS or MPEG-DASH.

projects.title: Immunogen
projects.description:
A top-down 2D casual puzzle/strategy game in which you, a super-cell, roam through the body fighting disease.
SAMMY 2014 AWARDS:
Runner-up for Visual Art award
Runner-up for the Grand Prize award
Award for Technical Achievement

projects.title: Medieval Terror: Attack on Leeland
projects.description:
A 2D game that takes place in a medieval town. You play as a terrifying gargoyle named “Wessbat”, trying to murder townsfolk and collect worksheets.

This game was created as part of the CMPS 179 class at UCSC.
